title: feat(2d): Slot Undercut for T-slot, keyseat, dovetail and lollipop cutters
body:
## What changed

This PR adds the Slot Undercut operation and the cutters for it.

- **Four cutter kinds** in `camcraft-tools`: `t_slot`, `keyseat`, `dovetail`, `lollipop`. They use the existing tool fields. `diameter` is the head. `flute_len` is the head height. `shank_d` and `shank_len` are the neck. `tip_angle` is the dovetail flank angle. The kind words are additive, so `PROJECT_VERSION` does not change. The starter catalog has one cutter of each kind.
- **One generator** in `camcraft-motion` (`machining2d::undercut`). It cuts a straight slot or a circular slot (DXF-style bulge). It changes Z at one XY station only, outside the wall. It feeds in sideways, cuts the centre pass and the radial stepover passes at one depth, feeds out the same way, then lifts. The pass offset comes from the widest point of the cutter profile, not from the tip.
- **One verify law** in `camcraft-sim` (`Mode::Undercut`, `verify/undercut.rs`). A move that changes Z while material is in or over the head is `Warning::UndercutLift`. It blocks the post. A neck or holder band with material above its bottom is a `ShankHit`. The operation layer reads the two again against the stock that the earlier operations left (`acquit_undercut_by_prior`). A neck slot that an earlier Slot operation cut is then air.
- **The true profile in the solid law.** The solid law judges a dovetail as a frustum and a lollipop as a full ball (`Prof::Dove`, `Prof::Ball`). The head top gets the same allowance as the tip, so a head that stands under its roof is contact and not a gouge.
- **The true profile in the field stock simulation** (`Stock::simulate_undercut`, `Stock::with_partial_undercut`, `SdfTool::Dovetail`). The head and the neck are two convex solids. The field keeps their union. Both the stock view and Simulate playback cut the head and neck with it. Notice `cut_twin_work::twin_tool` maps `SdfTool::Dovetail` to `"dovetail"`.
- **The column engines cut nothing for an undercut.** A column has one top for each (x, y). It cannot hold air below material.
- **App**: `OpParams::SlotUndercut` (kind tag 44, appended), the project file mirror (keeping `0.0` `bulge` and `neck_slot` keys in JSON), the stamp digest, heights, the part solid law for a part source, and the kept-parts law for both stock and part sources.
- **MCP**: `add_operation` with kind `Slot Undercut` (key `slot_undercut`) and `add_tool` with the new kind words. `verify` reports the new finding kind `undercut_lift`. `list_operation_types` and `edit_operation` include `bulge` and `neck_slot` when they equal `0.0`.
- **UI**: the four undercut kinds in the tool editor (`tool_undercut_row.rs` seeds valid defaults, `Flank angle (deg)` / `flank angle °` edits `ToolKind::Dovetail`, and `Corner radius` stays hidden for undercut kinds), the Slot Undercut page (`undercut_page.rs`), and five original icons (SVG masters rendered with `cargo xtask icons`).
- **Docs**: a Slot Undercut section in the 2D operations guide, and `docs/decisions/1444-slot-undercut.md`.

## UI screenshots

Before/after renders from the headless `ShellUi` (`1440x960` WGPU) on `upstream/main` (`5ed5b7fe2`) and this PR branch (images stored on `mkinney/Camcraft` `pr-screenshots` commit `0fd64401cc4acd068a1ec9e048417002176a3f86`):

| View | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| Tool editor (`DT-20-60` dovetail cutter) | ![Tool editor before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/0fd64401cc4acd068a1ec9e048417002176a3f86/2714/tool-editor-before.png) | ![Tool editor after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/0fd64401cc4acd068a1ec9e048417002176a3f86/2714/tool-editor-after.png) |
| Slot Undercut page (`TSlot` in milling setup) | ![Slot Undercut before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/0fd64401cc4acd068a1ec9e048417002176a3f86/2714/slot-undercut-before.png) | ![Slot Undercut after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/0fd64401cc4acd068a1ec9e048417002176a3f86/2714/slot-undercut-after.png) |

## Cause

There was no cutter kind with a head wider than its neck, and no operation for one. The laws for a plain contour are wrong below a roof. The column model reads a pass as a cleared kerf, so a lift through the roof passes as a retract in its own kerf.

## Tests

New pins cover the new behaviour. Each review fix below also has a direct test and mutation check.

- `camcraft-tools --lib` (`107 passed; 0 failed`): `undercut::tests` checks sane cutters, refusals by name, the profile contact point, and the drawn outline.
- `camcraft-motion --lib` (`459 passed; 0 failed; 10 ignored`): `machining2d::undercut::tests` pins single-station Z moves, entry slot refusals, concentric arc slots, profile contact offsets, and input refusals.
- `camcraft-sim --test undercut_laws` (`14 passed; 0 failed`): pins `UndercutLift`, `ShankHit`, `acquit_undercut_by_prior`, `Prof::Dove`, `Prof::Ball`, `Atom::cap`, and `Stock::simulate_undercut`.
- `camcraft-app --test mcp_slot_undercut` (`7 passed; 0 failed`): pins MCP cutting, verification, posting, refusals, `a_part_source_undercut_keeps_neighbouring_parts`, and `list_operation_types_and_edit_operation_keep_zero_bulge_and_neck_slot`.
- `camcraft-app --test stock_play` (`8 passed; 0 failed`): pins `playback_removes_undercut_head_and_neck_and_matches_field_view`.
- `camcraft-app --test stock_play_partial` (`4 passed; 0 failed`): pins `partial_move_cuts_undercut_head_and_neck_on_a_copy`.
- `camcraft-motion --test golden_undercut`: pins four golden CL files. The generator suite and its unchanged goldens now live in `crates/motion/tests/`.
- `camcraft-app --test tool_law` (`5 passed; 0 failed`): pins undercut cutter compatibility.
- `camcraft-ui --lib` (`1256 passed; 0 failed; 7 ignored`): includes `tool_undercut_row::tests`, `tool_cutter_params::each_milling_kind_shows_the_parameters_its_outline_is_drawn_from`, and `tests/tool_undercut.rs` (`new_tool_undercut_kinds_seed_sane_defaults_hide_corner_radius_and_show_dovetail_flank_angle`, `dovetail_properties_and_editor_edit_flank_angle_without_corner_radius`, and `slot_undercut_page_shows_its_geometry_heights_passes_and_feeds_fields`).

Review-fix mutation checks (guard reverted -> RED, restored -> GREEN):

- UI dovetail flank angle, undercut defaults, and corner-radius filter reverted: RED (`3 failed` across `tests/tool_undercut.rs` and `tool_cutter_params`). Restored: GREEN (`11 passed; 0 failed`).
- `is_part_kept_kind` reverted in `crates/app/src/operation/keep_law.rs`: `a_part_source_undercut_keeps_neighbouring_parts` RED (`post` succeeded instead of refusing). Restored: GREEN (`7 passed; 0 failed`).
- `skip_serializing_if = "is_zero"` restored in `crates/app/src/project/undercut_dto.rs`: `list_operation_types_and_edit_operation_keep_zero_bulge_and_neck_slot` RED (`list_operation_types` omitted `bulge` and `neck_slot`). Restored: GREEN (`7 passed; 0 failed`).
- `stock_play.rs` and `stock_play_head.rs` undercut playback handling reverted: `playback_removes_undercut_head_and_neck_and_matches_field_view` and `partial_move_cuts_undercut_head_and_neck_on_a_copy` RED. Restoring `stock_play.rs` alone kept `partial_move_cuts_undercut_head_and_neck_on_a_copy` RED. Restored both: GREEN (`8 passed; 0 failed` and `4 passed; 0 failed`).

Gate on `b95c27b2e52fc8b976ce9372bcc5e4141c247113`: `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed all 651 steps with zero failures (45.9 minutes). The merged main revision is `e5b0ca3c1`. It includes #2767, which fixes the four reviewed area-preview failures. The UI unit suite passed 1,258 tests (7 ignored). All 16 UI integration suites passed. `cargo clippy -j 12 -p camcraft-tools -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed with zero warnings.

Latest review-fix checks:

- The motion `golden_undercut` suite passed all four tests. Removing the motion test target gave RED. A feed change from 120 to 121 made all four goldens fail. Restoring the suite and feed returned all four tests to GREEN. The four CL files moved without byte changes.
- Reverting the main geometry fix gave exactly the four reviewed frame-cost failures. Restoring it returned all eight frame-cost tests to GREEN.
- The temporary literature audit gave RED on the old decision (0/8 checks) and GREEN on the updated decision (8/8). The decision records checked sources, design choices, and limitations. No audit script or review evidence is on this branch.

Current merge blocker: main advanced to `744c0847b04d54cfc6e3e8b24a21520c40b6bcef` during validation. A later local refresh exposes safety overlaps: `verify/avoid_poly.rs:25` omits `Atom::cap`, and `verify/swept.rs:130` omits `Prof::Dove` and `Prof::Ball` in keep-out dilation. The refresh compile checks and clippy are RED. The gate was stopped after the compile failures. No new collision semantics were selected. Local commit `b8c5cb42e` is not pushed. The pushed head and its GREEN gate remain `b95c27b2e`. The `Addressed:` comment records the blocker.

## Goldens moved

No existing golden changed. Four golden CL files are new:

- `slot_undercut_tslot_straight.cl`
- `slot_undercut_keyseat_arc.cl`
- `slot_undercut_dovetail_straight.cl`
- `slot_undercut_lollipop_arc.cl`

No snapshot PNG changed. Five icon PNGs are new (`cargo xtask icons` wrote them from the new SVG masters and changed no other PNG).

## Not exercised

- The literature search ran during the latest review fix. `docs/decisions/1444-slot-undercut.md` records checked handbook, Autodesk behaviour, and research sources for entry, exit, profiles, and field simulation. It records the limits of those sources and the implementation. The search used the web tool because Perplexity was unavailable. The implementation preceded this search.
- Dovetail and lollipop parts are not tested through the app. Their profiles are tested in the sim crate (solid law and field stock) and the generator.
- The program verdict before a post reads the stock from above. It does not show the undercut as removed. The undercut law and the solid law judge the operation instead.
- A flipped WCS and a rotated work offset refuse the kind. An aligned setup and a WCS yaw do not list it. No 3+2 tilt.
- One depth level for each operation. The far end of a blind slot stays square. The centre line is typed, not picked.
- Issue #896 (form cutters with a drawn outline, corner rounding, slitting saw) stays open. This PR adds only the four parametric kinds that #1444 needs.

## Overlaps

No open PR changes the same function. These open PRs change other functions in the same files. The PR that merges second refreshes.

- #2678, #2149: `mcp/job.rs`, `operation/generate.rs`, `project/file.rs`, `verify/mod.rs`, `verify/probe.rs`, `verify/types.rs`, `ui/state.rs`
- #2675, #2666: `operation/generate.rs`
- #2663: `ui/egui_app/tool_settings.rs`
- #2665, #2662, #1798: `ui/state.rs` (#1798 also `icons.rs`)
- #2594: `ui/egui_app/browser_tree.rs`

#2670, #2563, #1713, #1798, #2665, #2712, #2715, #2730, #2731, #2741, and #2742 merged while this work ran. Their changes are in the branch through the merge of `upstream/main` (`5ed5b7fe2`).

Effort: max. The issue did not escalate.

Changelog: Slot Undercut operation for T-slot, keyseat, dovetail and lollipop cutters: the cutter enters and leaves sideways at depth, a Z move with material over the head is refused, the neck is checked against the slot mouth, and the stock view shows the true undercut.

Fixes #1444
